age_calculation.name: Age Calculation
age_calculation.description: Calculates the subject's age at the time of the visit.

body_mass_index.name: Body Mass Index (BMI)
body_mass_index.description: Calculates the Body Mass Index, a measure of body fat based on height and weight.
body_mass_index.expression: BMI (kg/m^2) = Weight (kg) / (Height (m))^2. Assumes Height is in cm and needs conversion to meters.

body_surface_area_mosteller.name: Body Surface Area (BSA) - Mosteller Formula
body_surface_area_mosteller.description: Calculates the Body Surface Area, used for indexing various physiological measurements. Assumes height in cm and weight in kg.

waist_to_hip_ratio.name: Waist-to-Hip Ratio (WHR)
waist_to_hip_ratio.description: Calculates the ratio of waist circumference to hip circumference, an indicator of body fat distribution.

egfr_ckd_epi_2021.name: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR) - CKD-EPI 2021
egfr_ckd_epi_2021.description: Estimates GFR from serum creatinine, age, and sex using the 2021 Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration (CKD-EPI) equation. This is a standard method to assess kidney function.
egfr_ckd_epi_2021.expression: Calculated based on Serum Creatinine, Age, and Sex. The formula is complex and differs by sex and creatinine levels.

ast_alt_ratio.name: AST/ALT Ratio (De Ritis Ratio)
ast_alt_ratio.description: The ratio of Aspartate Aminotransferase (AST) to Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT). It can be used in the diagnosis of certain liver diseases.

fib_4_index.name: FIB-4 Index for Liver Fibrosis
fib_4_index.description: A non-invasive score to estimate the degree of liver fibrosis in patients with liver disease.

apri_score.name: APRI (AST to Platelet Ratio Index)
apri_score.description: A non-invasive score to assess the severity of liver fibrosis, particularly in hepatitis C.
apri_score.expression: APRI = ((ASAT / AST_Upper_Limit_Normal) / Platelets [10^9/L]) * 100. Assumes an AST ULN of 40 U/L.

homa_ir.name: HOMA-IR (Homeostatic Model Assessment for Insulin Resistance)
homa_ir.description: A method used to quantify insulin resistance and beta-cell function.

tyg_index.name: Triglyceride-Glucose (TyG) Index
tyg_index.description: An indicator of insulin resistance, calculated from fasting triglycerides and glucose.
tyg_index.expression: TyG Index = ln(Triglycerides [mg/dL] * Fasting glycemia [mg/dL] / 2). Requires unit conversion if source units are mmol/L.

stroke_volume_simpson.name: Stroke Volume (SV) by Simpson's Method
stroke_volume_simpson.description: The volume of blood pumped from the left ventricle per beat, calculated as the difference between end-diastolic and end-systolic volumes.

cardiac_output_simpson.name: Cardiac Output (CO) by Simpson's Method
cardiac_output_simpson.description: The volume of blood pumped by the heart per minute, calculated from stroke volume and heart rate.

cardiac_index.name: Cardiac Index (CI)
cardiac_index.description: Cardiac output indexed to body surface area, providing a more comparable measure of heart performance across individuals of different sizes.
cardiac_index.expression: CI (L/min/m^2) = Cardiac Output / Body Surface Area

relative_wall_thickness.name: Relative Wall Thickness (RWT)
relative_wall_thickness.description: An echocardiographic measurement used to classify the pattern of left ventricular hypertrophy.

lv_mass_devereux.name: Left Ventricular Mass (Devereux Formula)
lv_mass_devereux.description: Calculates the mass of the left ventricle using a standard echocardiographic formula.

e_e_prime_ratio_average.name: E/e' Ratio (Average)
e_e_prime_ratio_average.description: A key echocardiographic parameter for estimating left ventricular filling pressures and diagnosing diastolic dysfunction. Calculated using the average of septal and lateral e' velocities.

left_atrial_volume_index.name: Left Atrial Volume Index (LAVI)
left_atrial_volume_index.description: Left atrial volume indexed to body surface area, a robust marker of chronic diastolic dysfunction and cardiovascular risk.

estimated_spap.name: Estimated Systolic Pulmonary Artery Pressure (sPAP)
estimated_spap.description: Estimates the systolic pressure in the pulmonary artery using the simplified Bernoulli equation on the tricuspid regurgitation jet velocity. Assumes a fixed Right Atrial Pressure (RAP).
estimated_spap.expression: sPAP (mmHg) = 4 * (TR Vmax)^2 + RAP. Assumes RAP is 5, 10, or 15 mmHg.

cholesterol_conversion_mmol_to_g.name: Cholesterol Unit Conversion (mmol/L to g/L)
cholesterol_conversion_mmol_to_g.description: Converts cholesterol concentration from mmol/L to g/L.

triglycerides_conversion_mmol_to_g.name: Triglycerides Unit Conversion (mmol/L to g/L)
triglycerides_conversion_mmol_to_g.description: Converts triglyceride concentration from mmol/L to g/L.
